fields.customer_statement: I ordered a espresso machine from NovaMart on July 5 for $449.99. The estimated delivery window shown at checkout was July 8-10. I never received the package. I checked with my building's front desk and my neighbors, and nobody signed for or saw a delivery. I emailed the merchant on July 12 and July 15 asking for an update and did not get a helpful response. I would like a full refund since I never received the item.
